pick.headline: IRA bomb at Brighton hotel narrowly misses Thatcher
pick.summary: On October 12, 1984, an IRA bomb exploded at the Grand Hotel in Brighton during the Conservative Party conference, killing five people. Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher escaped unhurt.
pick.significance: The attack was the IRA's closest attempt on a British prime minister.
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of October 12, 1984, carried Moscow TASS International Service in Russian: a powerful explosion rocked Thatcher's Brighton hotel during the Conservative conference, with no ministers hurt and the cause under investigation.
